description: Knowledge base for Step-Complete Application Submission of the Water Licence Application. Covers additional information guidelines, payment methods, and final submission instructions.

knowledge_items.title: What to Include in the Additional other Information Field
keywords: what to write in additional information
knowledge_items.content: Applicants may provide any extra information relevant to supporting their water licence application. Only include information that is relevant to the application. Do NOT include personal information such as names, addresses, or contact details of individuals. Information should support or clarify the application context only. If the applicant has an existing water licence, they can share any relevant details in this section.

knowledge_items.title: Pay by Cheque or Money Order (Mail or Drop-Off)
knowledge_items.content: You have decided to pay your fees via a cheque or money order. Please download and print the remittance form on the next page. You can drop off or mail in your cheque or money order along with your remittance form to any FrontCounter BC location. Be sure to make your cheque or money order payable to the 'Minister of Finance'.

knowledge_items.title: Pay In Person at a FrontCounter BC Office
knowledge_items.content: You have decided to pay your fees in person at a FrontCounter BC location. Please download and print the remittance form on the next page. Bring your remittance form with you when making your payment. You may also mail in your cheque or money order along with the remittance form to any FrontCounter BC location. Be sure to make your cheque or money order payable to the 'Minister of Finance'.

knowledge_items.title: Pay by Credit Card Online
knowledge_items.content: You can use Visa, Visa Debit, MasterCard, Debit MasterCard, or American Express to make an online credit card payment.

knowledge_items.title: Final Submission Instructions
knowledge_items.content: Applicants must select a FrontCounter BC office for submission. Submission method and payment type determine required next steps such as remittance form generation and payment processing. Application submission is completed after payment selection and submission details are confirmed.
